entities.summary:
Athens University of Economics and Business is a public university based in Athens, Greece, specializing in the fields of Economics, Business Administration, and Information Technology. It encompasses a broad range of academic disciplines, including Statistics, Accounting and Finance, Computer Science, and European Studies. The university offers education at the undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels while also promoting research.

AUEB is recognized as the leading institution for economic and business studies in Greece. Athens University of Economics and Business is a university in Athens, established in 1920-06-18. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

This has had significant regional impact on Greek education and research.
